name: Docker Run to Compose Converter
summary: Convert docker run commands into docker-compose.yml services.
description: Paste a docker run one-liner and get an equivalent Compose service with image, ports, env vars, volumes, and restart policy mapped automatically.

faqs.question: Which flags are supported?
faqs.answer: Common flags: -d, --name, -p, -e, -v, --restart, plus image and command arguments.

faqs.question: Production ready?
faqs.answer: Treat output as a starting point — review networking, secrets, and health checks before deploying.
